description: This file serves as an initializer for the 'openpipe' module, importing everything from the local 'llm' submodule and replacing the module reference with a proxy for deprecation handling.

classes.name: DeprecatedModuleProxy
classes.description: A proxy class used to mark the module as deprecated, indicating to users that it will be removed or relocated in future versions.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the DeprecatedModuleProxy with the original module's globals, a name, and a deprecation message or key.
